name: DeepLensX
description: DeepLensX is a Streamlit app that integrates MobileNetV2 and a CIFAR-10 model for image classification. Users can upload images and receive predictions with confidence scores from either model. It features a sleek navigation bar for easy switching and real-time results, ideal for both learning and practical use.

features: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet): Recognizes 1,000 different classes from the ImageNet dataset, including everyday objects, animals, and vehicles.
Custom CIFAR-10 Model: Specializes in classifying images into one of ten specific categories such as airplanes, automobiles, and birds.
Navigation Bar: Seamlessly switch between MobileNetV2 and CIFAR-10 models using a sleek sidebar menu.
Real-Time Classification: Upload an image to receive immediate predictions with confidence scores.
